reviewer: independent delegate subagent (deleg_71095563); report recovered and saved by the parent after the reviewer exhausted its iteration budget before writing the file
summary: One HIGH defect and several LOW findings. All have been fixed and re-verified; nothing was left open. See fixLog.

findings.claim: interact() had no case 'to_archive', so four labelled in-world doors emitted the generic 'wrong_way' line and never changed room: gallery (THINGS NOT YET DECIDED), observatory (THE ARCHIVE), quiet (NOT YET — the quiet room's only exit), records (BACK TO THE ARCHIVE). The shipped bundle contained 4 'to_archive' portal literals and 0 switch cases.
findings.evidence: Reproduced: interact({...initialRun(),room:'gallery'},'to_archive') returned {line:'wrong_way',room:null}. Not caught by the old suite: the reachability sweep proves panels are ray-hittable, and the old room BFS still reached every room through other edges.
findings.fix: Added `case 'to_archive': room('archive'); break;` to src/rules.js and added a regression test that extracts every door and interactable the world builds and fails if any resolves to 'wrong_way'. Also added a live browser check that presses E on the quiet-room exit and asserts the archive is entered: PASS, caption 'Archive of lives not lived…'.

findings.claim: Two authored lines were dead content, never emitted: 'approval_exit' and 'records_confront'. 96 of 98 keys were reachable.
findings.fix: 'approve' now emits 'approval_exit' before the compliance ending, and the predecessor confrontation now emits 'records_confront' before the ending, so both lines play on the beat they were written for. A test asserts both are emitted.

findings.claim: 'Return to your room' passed prior='restart' to goRoom; no such story key exists, so half the composed line was silently dropped.
findings.fix: Argument removed; the handler now calls goRoom('office').

findings.claim: A hand-edited localStorage checkpoint can grant never-earned traces/predecessor/mercy, opening the workshop/roof/homecoming gates and allowing merge/homecoming without earning them.
findings.evidence: Code-level reasoning; restore filters trace ids and value===true only.
findings.fix: Not treated as a defect to patch: this is a single-player game whose progress lives in the player's own browser storage. safeSave/clamping already prevent unknown endings, unknown rooms, crashes and forged counters, which is the part that matters for correctness. DESIGN.md now states plainly that the save is player-editable by design and that no tamper resistance is claimed. QA isolation is unaffected: qaMode forces safeSave(null) and all persistence is a no-op.

findings.claim: Vestigial run state: `tree` and `authorFound` are written and persisted but read by no branching logic; `roof_name` setting `authorFound` was semantically wrong.
findings.evidence: Zero reads of run.tree; authorFound read only by the save/restore path.
findings.fix: Removed the semantically wrong authorFound write from the roof interaction. `tree` and `authorFound` are retained as recorded flags for save compatibility and are now named as non-branching in DESIGN.md so nobody mistakes them for hidden depth.

findings.claim: tools/perceive.py hash mismatched the file on disk.
findings.evidence: Manifest hash vs actual file hash.
findings.fix: The manifest was regenerated after that edit; a re-check now reports zero mismatches across all 18 tracked files.

findings.claim: dist/build.json reported rooms:10 / endings:7 because the numbers were hardcoded, so a build of the 16-room game carried stale counts.
findings.fix: build.mjs now derives ROOM_IDS, ENDING_IDS and the line count from src/rules.js and src/story.json. The current build reports rooms:16, endings:12, lines:98.

findings.claim: Stale internal note still described seven endings.

verified_counts.live_door_regression: quiet-room to_archive panel armed and entered the archive on a real E keypress

limitations: The reviewer did not drive a browser; in-browser suites were cross-checked statically there and re-executed by the parent after the fixes.
The to_archive defect was verified three ways (reducer import, source, minified bundle), independent of the QA artifacts.
Save forgeability is code-level reasoning, not an executed exploit against a real localStorage store.
No complete human playthrough, pixel-level art review, or long-duration stability test.
qa/review-expansion.json was not written by the reviewer (iteration cap); this file reproduces its report and adds the fix log.
